_comment: Per-host flags (plan E1). The build reads one block (SITE_ENV=dev or www). In this prototype, core.js picks the block from the hostname, and ?site=www previews the www block on any host. A claim flag stays false until its check (plan Part H) is done on production or its owner decision is taken; tests/story.test.mjs fails if a rolling_out key matches no element on the page.
